To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the flavone L7G improves plasma lipid profile by increasing fatty acid oxidation in liver and inhibiting the expression of the key enzyme in cholesterol biosynthesis.
the flavone L7G, a dietary flavonoid abundant in plant foods such as aromatic plants, is able to modulate the expression of key genes involved in lipid metabolism in rat liver.

dietary supplementation with the flavone L7G induced the expression of PPAR-α and of its target genes CPT-1 and PDK-4, and repressed HMGCR expression and activity in the liver of rats fed a high fat diet.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the molecular mechanisms underlying the effects of dietary flavonoids on lipid metabolism.
the elucidation of the molecular mechanisms behind dietary flavonoids effects on lipid metabolism and their potential use in the prevention and/or treatment of metabolic diseases.

the effects of the flavonoid luteolin- 7-glucosides, a natural component of Mediterranean diet, in whole-body lipid homeostasis, with particular attention to the molecular mechanisms of action in liver.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the dietary supplementation of L7G for a short period of time induces the expression of the genes involved in the beta-oxidation pathway, without affecting the genes involved in de novo fatty acid biosynthesis and cholesterol synthesis.
the flavone L7G has a positive impact on whole body metabolism by increasing fatty acid oxidation and decreasing de novo lipogenesis and cholesterol biosynthesis in the liver.

the flavone L7G, which is abundant in aromatic herbs of the Mediterranean diet, may help in preventing the onset of metabolic diseases by regulating the expression of genes involved in whole body lipid metabolism.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
L7G is a natural flavone which can be used in the treatment of dyslipidemias and NAFLD.

L7G is a flavone which is abundant in plant food of Mediterranean diet and it has a positive effect on whole-body lipid metabolism, by activating PPAR-α, and inhibiting SREBP-1c, and HMGCoAR, which may contribute to prevent NAFLD and CVD.
the dietary flavone luteoline-7-glucocide is a potent activator of PPAR-alpha and CPT-1 in the liver and that it may be useful in preventing or treating dyslipidemia and fatty liver.
The main takeaway from our work is that
luteolin- 7-glucosylate may help prevent metabolic diseases by regulating the expression of genes involved in the regulation of lipid metabolism.

the dietary supplementation with Luteolin- 7-glucosidewas able to induce the expression of PPARα and CPT-1, and to inhibit HMGCR activity, which are all important molecular mechanisms in whole-body lipid homeostasis.
luteolin- 7-glucosides may be used in the prevention and treatment of metabolic disorders such as NAFLD and cardiovascular diseases.
